sample.lesson: Prose: The Portrait of a Lady
sample.summary: My grandmother, like everybody’s grandmother, was an old woman. My grandmother always went to school with me because the school was attached to the temple. Although we shared the same room, my grandmother no longer came to school with me. She broke it into little crumbs, the way my grandmother used to, and threw it to them. Describe the author’s grandmother. b. What was the daily routine of the grandmother at home?
